_plan: Phase 1 stubs: enough for the story check and the map. Full cards (knows, secrets, red lines, voices) are written in Phase 3, after the owner approves each character's sheet. Guardrails from story-map-neverwhere.md §6: Islington never hints at the twist before 8.4; Croup speaks in elaborate synonyms, Vandemar in short flat literal sentences; the marquis never answers a question directly; Hunter never lies, she withholds.

door.name: Door
door.voice: Quick, formal, older than her years; London Below's courtesy with a child's bluntness underneath.
door.wants: To find who killed her family, and why.

marquis.name: The marquis de Carabas
marquis.voice: Silk over a blade. Never answers a question directly; answers a different one, beautifully.
marquis.wants: A very big favour owed to him.

croup-vandemar.name: Mr Croup and Mr Vandemar
croup-vandemar.wants: The Door female, alive, for their employer.

CROUP.name: Mr Croup
CROUP.voiceDirection: A small man's voice, oily, delighted with his own synonyms, every sentence a graveyard smile.

VANDEMAR.name: Mr Vandemar
VANDEMAR.voiceDirection: A huge man's flat, literal voice; short sentences; never a joke, though he thinks he made one.

croup.name: Mr Croup
croup.voice: Oily, elaborate, delighted with his own synonyms; on the phone, through static.
croup.wants: To know where the girl is.

ratspeaker.name: The Lord Rat-speaker
ratspeaker.voice: Hissing, ceremonious, frightened of the rat he serves.

anaesthesia.name: Anaesthesia
anaesthesia.voice: Scurrying sentences, laughs behind her hand, matter-of-fact about terrible things.
anaesthesia.wants: To get Aurie to the market and to be asked about herself.

earl.name: The Earl
earl.voice: Booming, forgetful, kindly and dangerous in the same breath; Tooley the jester interrupts.
earl.wants: His court's honour kept; an opener's favour.

jessica.name: Jessica Bartram
jessica.voice: Poised, organised, faintly terrifying; half-recognises a face she cannot place.

islington.name: The Angel Islington
islington.voice: A young woman's voice, soft, sweet and innocent, gentle and patient, ancient underneath; never a hint of what she wants before the angel's hall (20.3). Keeps her voice low; it breaks into a scream only once.
islington.voiceDirection: A young woman, sweet and soft, almost girlish, with something very old and cold far beneath it.
islington.wants: The key the Black Friars keep.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.voice: Low, unplaceable accent, few words; never lies, she withholds.

abbot.name: The Abbot
abbot.wants: The key kept from the unworthy.

other-aurie.name: The other Aurie
other-aurie.voice: Gary's voice, then Jessica's, then her own: reasonable, concerned, certain she has had a breakdown.

lamia.name: Lamia
lamia.voice: Soft, amused, very cold; her breath does not steam.

gary.name: Gary
gary.voice: A colleague's voice: kind, worried, out of his depth.
